summary: The middle rungs put recognizable character habits into small social decisions. Several callbacks, scene props and costs depend on facts the encounter has not established.

issues.problem: The empty hook is the title and the scene focal point, but the opening explicitly says the missing regular's cup is still on its hook, and the left result has Mabel take it down only after your visit.
issues.fix: Use the cup left on its hook as the opening image, or establish who removed it and when.

issues.problem: This can be the first normal tea service with Mabel after reaching the relationship gate, but it states that she always brings the calm blend before the player sits and that she was reading last year's player. Existing tea orders have several possible blends.
issues.fix: Describe her making a confident guess this time. Gate the habitual blend on a specific established order if the previous routine is part of the scene.

issues.problem: The professor makes the favor the explicit stakes of the first challenge and in one win says it is owed, but no win grants a favor or a way to claim it. The repeated card can accumulate the same promise.
issues.fix: Make the wager immediate, or award a callable favor when the trick succeeds.

issues.problem: In the linked second variant the griffin has a thorn in its paw, but the ask-for-a-full-sentence outcome removes a splinter, which is the first variant's hippogriff injury. The owl loss also deducts the same Health as the bite and griffin strike without describing an injury.
issues.fix: Keep the correct animal and injury in each linked outcome and show the physical price of the owl scramble if it retains the Health loss.

issues.problem: One story she tells ends with a bite and explicitly no moral, although the opening, her worldbook voice and her stories fact all say the bite and moral are her fixed form.
issues.fix: Let the owl story end with a moral, or make the missing one clearly an exercise she expects the player to complete.

issues.problem: The third sitting variant says the conversation lasted longer than intended but never says it displaced study, unlike the other two. The same Study penalty applies.
issues.fix: Mention the reading or notes left undone in that variant, or change its cost.
